CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.quintzee_board_deal(s jsonb, at_ms bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ BEGIN IF s#>>'{rules,version}'='quintzee/3' THEN RETURN private.quintzee_v3_board_start((s->'rules')-'theme',at_ms,coalesce((s->>'score')::bigint,0));END IF;
 IF s#>>'{rules,version}'='quintzee/2' THEN RETURN private.quintzee_v2_board_start((s->'rules')-'theme',at_ms,coalesce((s->>'score')::bigint,0));END IF;RETURN private.quintzee_v1_board_start((s->'rules')-'theme',at_ms,coalesce((s->>'score')::bigint,0));END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.quintzee_board_reduce(b jsonb, action text, items integer[], at_ms bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ BEGIN IF b#>>'{rules,version}'='quintzee/3' THEN RETURN private.quintzee_v3_board_reduce(b,action,items,at_ms);END IF;
 IF b#>>'{rules,version}'='quintzee/2' THEN RETURN private.quintzee_v2_board_reduce(b,action,items,at_ms);END IF;
 RETURN private.quintzee_v1_board_reduce(b,action,items,at_ms);END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.quintzee_default_rules()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE seconds_i integer;
BEGIN
 SELECT quintzee_round_seconds INTO STRICT seconds_i FROM public.game_defaults WHERE game_type='quintzee';
 RETURN private.quintzee_v3_rules(seconds_i*1000);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.quintzee_v3_board_start(r jsonb, at_ms bigint, score_before bigint DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ BEGIN
 PERFORM private.quintzee_v3_validate_rules(r);
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('rules',r,'phase','ready','deadline',at_ms+(r->>'readyMs')::bigint,
 'dice','[]'::jsonb,'held','[]'::jsonb,'rollsRemaining',3,'rollSerial',0,'scores','{}'::jsonb,
 'scoreBefore',score_before,'score',score_before,'result',NULL,'potentials','{}'::jsonb);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.quintzee_v3_categories()
 RETURNS text[]
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ SELECT ARRAY['ones','twos','threes','fours','fives','sixes',
 'three_of_a_kind','four_of_a_kind','yahtzee','full_house','large_straight','chance']::text[] $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.quintzee_v3_die()
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE n integer;
BEGIN
 -- Rejection sampling: 252 is divisible by six; never use biased byte % 6.
 LOOP n:=get_byte(extensions.gen_random_bytes(1),0); EXIT WHEN n<252; END LOOP;
 RETURN 1+n%6;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.quintzee_v3_rules(duration_ms integer DEFAULT 180000, clear_bonus integer DEFAULT 35)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF duration_ms IS NULL OR duration_ms<=0 OR clear_bonus IS NULL OR clear_bonus<0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'quintzee:config'; END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('version','quintzee/3','durationMs',duration_ms,'clearBonus',clear_bonus,
  'upperThreshold',63,'upperBonus',35,'bonusThreshold',80000,'rounds',2,'maxRounds',3,
  'upperCelebrationMs',1500,'baseCountMs',600,'readyMs',30000,'introMs',2500,'resultMs',9000,'speedMin',100,'speedRange',200);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.quintzee_v3_speed(remaining_ms bigint, duration_ms bigint)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT 100+(200*greatest(0,least(duration_ms,remaining_ms))/duration_ms)::integer
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.quintzee_v3_start(players uuid[], r jsonb, at_ms bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE totals jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF cardinality(players) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4 OR cardinality(players) IS NULL OR array_position(players,NULL) IS NOT NULL
 OR (SELECT count(DISTINCT p) FROM unnest(players) p)<>cardinality(players) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'quintzee:players'; END IF;
 SELECT jsonb_object_agg(p::text,0) INTO totals FROM unnest(players) p;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('rules',r,'players',to_jsonb(players),'scores',totals,'round',1,'turnIndex',0,'qualified','[]'::jsonb,
 'results','[]'::jsonb,'finished',false,'board',private.quintzee_v3_board_start(r,at_ms));
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.quintzee_v3_validate_rules(r jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ BEGIN
 IF r IS DISTINCT FROM private.quintzee_v3_rules((r->>'durationMs')::integer,(r->>'clearBonus')::integer)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'quintzee:rules_version'; END IF;
END $function$
